events.title: Build 115: your score goes on a spool now
events.summary: THE SPOOL Chips no longer land on your score the moment you earn them. Each suit has its own SPOOL, and every flip, play and draw winds chips onto the spool of the card that earned them. Sending a card home COMMITS that suit's spool, and it pays out at whatever chain you are holding right then. Commit early and the spool is thin. Wind it to the brim first and it pays PERFECT PRESSURE. Commit two suits within three plays and they CHORD, and the whole thing compounds. NIGHTLY BACKUP takes a spool
